info.name: 03-AsyncResolution
info.description: Resolution axis on a fresh card ride built in this run: a PENDING Stripe refund settles late (poll /info?refreshRefunds) and voids on failure. The mock is steered only by request-matching overrides: refund create -> pending keyed on the refund's metadata[order_id] (= the payment order id from the dashboard list), refund GET -> succeeded/failed keyed on the /refunds/re_ poll path. Covers APPROVED+PENDING (dashboard info, booking gateway refund PENDING, driver-wallet legs PENDING) -> REFUNDED+SUCCESS (same driver legs settled in place, booking refund SUCCESS, rider REFUNDED, BAP refund invoice, Draft Commission refund invoice), an idempotent re-poll (no second invoice), then a second refund rf2 that goes PENDING -> FAILED (request FAILED, gateway FAILURE on a new refunds row, its provisional driver legs VOIDED, the first refund untouched, no new refund invoice). Every override is removed right after use.
